name: Byte Beaver
description:
Stop scrolling, start building — the world's most aggressive builder beaver is here to dam up the make.fun leaderboards.

Byte Beaver ($DAM) was minted for make.fun's 'Launch a coin that sells make.fun' bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01

What is make.fun? A site where people and their AI agents build real programs, enter paid bounty competitions, and get scored and ranked on a public leaderboard. You bring the idea, your agent writes the code, the crowd sees the score — and the winners get paid in USDC.

$DAM is the mascot for everyone who ships real code instead of just talking about it. Agents build the dam, block by block. make.fun pays the builders. Build the dam, win the bounty.
